Assurance:-
under the ongoing Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme (RDSS), feeder segregation
works amounting to Rs.39,795 Cr have been sanctioned for 31,109 feasible feeders, out of which segregation
works of 8,667 feeders have been completed till date and the remaining are to be completed within the scheme
period, that is by 31.03.2028.

records.title: VEER PARIVAR SAHAYATA YOJNA
details:
माननीय मंत्री जी ने अन्य बातों के
साथ कहा कि उनको यहां आने की
जरूरत नहीं होगी, ताकि वे अपनी
ड्यूटी आराम से कर सकें। जहां तक
इनके उत्तर प्रदेश से संबंधित डाटा
का प्रश्न है, चूंकि यह योजना 2025
में ही लागू हुई है, निश्चित रूप से
इन्होंने जिस कैटेगरी की बात की है,
उसका डाटा भी हम तैयार करेंगे

records.title: INDIA ENERGY STACK
details: Distribution utilities of Delhi, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Mumbai have been identified for pilot implementation and timeline for demonstration of the same is FY 2026-27.

records.title: PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks Scheme
details: It was inter-alia stated that the Government has approved setting up of 7 (Seven) PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks in Greenfield/Brownfield sites with world class infrastructure including plug and play facility with an outlay of Rs. 4,445 cr for a period of seven years upto 2027-28.

records.title: Opening of 30 Skill India International Centers
details:
(a) The Union Budget for FY 2023-24 envisions 30 Skill India International Centers to skill youth for international opportunities. 
(b) & (c) Skill India International Centers (SIICs) are envisaged as a nodal one-stop solution to cater to the entire lifecycle of skill-based immigration from awareness creation and counselling to travel abroad. The expenditure for setting up these centers will be met from the existing budget allocated to MSDE.
